maintenance_led.reason: Sells software licences and subscriptions (Telerik, Sitefinity, MarkLogic, Chef, OpenEdge, Flowmon); renewals exist, but not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private enterprises and software developers across industries; Federal Solutions for government is a small part.
